title: rack-parts input
description: Input for the rack-parts generator. All lengths in mm. x-kind says where a value must come from: 'measured' (measure the real rack/device), 'chosen' (design choice), 'tolerance' (clearance you tune), 'label'. Schema bounds are coarse; the generator also runs cross-field geometry checks that the schema cannot express.

name.description: Output basename: 1-48 chars of a-z, 0-9 and '-', starting with a letter or digit.

units.description: All lengths are millimetres. Must be "mm".

facets.description: Polygon segments per circle ($fn). Holes are enlarged so the polygon still clears the stated diameter.

min_wall_mm.description: Minimum material left between any hole/counterbore and a part edge or another hole.

part.description: Selects the L-shaped rack ear bracket.

rack_width_class.description: Only selects a sanity window for rail_hole_center_spacing_mm (catches inch/mm mix-ups). It does not supply any dimension.

hand.description: Which side of the device, viewed from the front. 'left' is the X-mirror of 'right'.

rail_hole_center_spacing_mm.description: Horizontal centre-to-centre distance between the left and right rail mounting holes.

rail_opening_width_mm.description: Clear horizontal opening between the inner edges of the left and right rails (narrowest point along the depth the bracket occupies).

max_overall_width_mm.description: Widest the pair of front flanges may be (e.g. rack panel width or nearest obstruction).

rail_hole_z_offsets_mm.description: Rail hole centres used, measured upward from the bottom edge of the bracket as it will sit in the rack. 1-8 values.

rail_screw_clearance_diameter_mm.description: Through-hole diameter for the rack screw (screw major diameter + your clearance).

rail_screw_head_diameter_mm.description: Rack screw (or washer) head diameter; the head must bear fully on the front flange.

rail_slot_extra_length_mm.description: Horizontal slot elongation of each rail hole for side-to-side adjustment (0 = round hole).

rail_side_clearance_mm.description: Gap required between the bracket/device-screw heads and the inner rail edge.

device_width_mm.description: Device width across the faces the brackets attach to.

device_side_gap_mm.description: Gap between the device side and the bracket side flange.

device_setback_mm.description: Distance from the bracket front face back to the device front face (negative = device protrudes forward).

device_bottom_offset_mm.description: Height of the device bottom above the bracket bottom edge.

device_screw_positions_mm.description: Device side screw holes as [y, z]: y back from the device front face, z up from the device bottom. 1-8 pairs.

device_screw_clearance_diameter_mm.description: Through-hole diameter in the side flange for the device screw.

device_screw_head_height_mm.description: Device screw head height; it sits on the outside of the side flange, next to the rail.

flange_height_mm.description: Height of the bracket (both flanges). For 19-inch gear this is usually a little under n x 44.45 mm.

side_flange_depth_mm.description: How far the side flange extends back from the front face.

gusset_mm.description: Leg length of the triangular corner gusset (0 = none).

part.description: Selects the U-shaped small-form-factor PC cradle.

device_orientation.description: 'flat': device sits on its bottom. 'on_side': device stands on a side, so its height becomes the cradle width.

device_width_mm.description: Device width in its normal (flat) pose.

device_height_mm.description: Device height in its normal (flat) pose.

fit_clearance_mm.description: Gap added on each side of the device inside the cradle (and above it, under the lip).

cradle_length_mm.description: Cradle length along the device depth.

wall_clear_height_mm.description: Clear height inside the cradle from the base top to the wall top (or to the underside of the lip).

retention_lip_mm.description: Inward lip at the top of each wall (0 = none).

shelf_hole_positions_mm.description: Mounting holes as [x, y]: x from the cradle centreline, y back from the cradle front edge. Must match holes you measured on your shelf or panel. 1-12 pairs.

shelf_screw_clearance_diameter_mm.description: Through-hole diameter for the shelf screw.

shelf_screw_head_diameter_mm.description: Shelf screw head diameter (counterbored from the top).

shelf_screw_head_height_mm.description: Shelf screw head height; the counterbore is this deep so the head sits flush or below the base top.

name.description: Output basename: 1-48 chars of a-z, 0-9 and '-', starting with a letter or digit.

units.description: All lengths are millimetres. Must be "mm".

min_wall_mm.description: Minimum material left between any hole/counterbore and a part edge or another hole.

part.description: Selects a drop-in cradle for a small network switch: front/rear stop tabs, strap slots, vent windows, base vent slots and counterbored shelf holes.

device_width_mm.description: Switch width (left to right, viewed from the front).

device_height_mm.description: Switch height, including feet if they stay on.

device_depth_mm.description: Switch depth, front face to rear face (excluding plugs).

fit_clearance_mm.description: Gap added on every side of the switch inside the cradle (left/right, front/back, and above it under the strap slot).

wall_thickness_mm.description: Side wall thickness; also the front/rear stop tab thickness.

stop_tab_width_mm.description: How far each front/rear stop tab reaches inward from its side wall. Must overlap the device face by at least min_wall_mm beyond fit_clearance_mm.

stop_tab_height_mm.description: Height of the stop tabs above the base top.

front_port_zone_mm.description: Front-face regions that must stay unobstructed (ports, LEDs, buttons) as [x0, x1, z0, z1]. 0-4 rectangles.

rear_port_zone_mm.description: Rear-face regions that must stay unobstructed (power jack, ports) as [x0, x1, z0, z1]. 0-4 rectangles.

side_vent_zone_mm.description: Side vent regions as [y0, y1, z0, z1]: y back from the device front face, z up from the device bottom. A window of exactly this size is cut through both side walls. 0-4 rectangles.

strap_slot_y_mm.description: Centre of each strap slot pair, measured back from the device front face. The strap crosses the top of the switch and wraps around the bar above each slot. 1-4 values.

strap_slot_length_mm.description: Slot length along the depth: strap width + your clearance.

strap_slot_height_mm.description: Slot height: strap thickness + your clearance.

strap_bar_height_mm.description: Height of the wall material above each strap slot that the strap wraps around.

base_vent_slot_count.description: Number of rounded vent slots in the base under the switch (0 = none).

base_vent_slot_width_mm.description: Width of each base vent slot.

base_vent_slot_length_mm.description: Length of each base vent slot (along the depth, centred on the cradle).

base_vent_slot_pitch_mm.description: Centre-to-centre spacing of base vent slots.

shelf_hole_positions_mm.description: Mounting holes as [x, y]: x from the cradle centreline, y back from the cradle front edge. Must match holes you measured on your shelf or panel. 1-12 pairs.

shelf_screw_clearance_diameter_mm.description: Through-hole diameter for the shelf screw.

shelf_screw_head_diameter_mm.description: Shelf screw head diameter (counterbored from the top).

shelf_screw_head_height_mm.description: Shelf screw head height; the counterbore is this deep so the head sits flush or below the base top.

build_plate_x_mm.description: Usable build plate size, first axis (measure your printer).

build_plate_y_mm.description: Usable build plate size, second axis.

part.description: Selects a flat blanking panel that screws to measured rail holes.

rack_width_class.description: Only selects a sanity window for rail_hole_center_spacing_mm (catches inch/mm mix-ups). It does not supply any dimension; there is no universal 10-inch hole pattern.

rail_hole_center_spacing_mm.description: Horizontal centre-to-centre distance between the left and right rail mounting holes.

rail_opening_width_mm.description: Clear horizontal opening between the inner edges of the rails over the depth the panel's stiffeners occupy.

panel_width_mm.description: Overall panel width: the space available in front of the rails (19-inch nominal 482.6; 10-inch: measure).

panel_height_mm.description: Panel height. Usually a little under n x 44.45 mm so neighbouring panels do not touch.

rail_hole_z_offsets_mm.description: Rail hole centres used, measured upward from the panel bottom edge as it will sit in the rack. The same heights are used on the left and right rail. 1-8 values.

rail_screw_clearance_diameter_mm.description: Through-hole diameter for the rack screw (screw major diameter + your clearance).

rail_screw_head_diameter_mm.description: Rack screw (or washer) head diameter; the head must bear fully on the panel.

rail_slot_extra_length_mm.description: Horizontal slot elongation of each rail hole for side-to-side adjustment (0 = round hole).

rail_side_clearance_mm.description: Gap kept between anything behind the panel (stiffening ribs, shelf floor and walls) and the inner rail edge.

stiffener_depth_mm.description: Depth of the two horizontal stiffening ribs along the top and bottom edges of the back face (0 = flat plate). Ribs stop inside the rail opening.

stiffener_thickness_mm.description: Vertical thickness of each stiffening rib (ignored when stiffener_depth_mm is 0, but still required).

build_plate_x_mm.description: Usable build plate size, first axis (measure your printer).

build_plate_y_mm.description: Usable build plate size, second axis.

allow_oversize_print.description: false: refuse a panel whose face does not fit the build plate in either rotation. true: generate it anyway and flag it in the manifest; no split/joint is produced, so you need a larger printer or another process.

pass_through_centers_mm.description: Pass-through centres as [x, z]: x from the rack centreline (+x to the right, viewed from the front), z up from the panel bottom edge. 1-8 pairs.

pass_through_width_mm.description: Narrowest (mid-thickness) width of each horizontal stadium opening, end to end.

pass_through_height_mm.description: Narrowest (mid-thickness) height of each opening; also the diameter of its round ends. Must not exceed the width.

pass_through_edge_radius_mm.description: Radius of the rounded edge on both faces around each opening; at most half the panel thickness. The opening on each face is wider and taller than the neck by twice this radius.

cable_bundle_diameter_mm.description: Largest connector or cable bundle diameter that must pass through; the opening neck must be at least this tall.

part.description: Selects a shallow ventilated shelf: a front plate on measured rail holes with a cantilevered floor, side walls, optional rear lip and vent slots. Only 10-inch is generated; 19-inch is refused (deferred).

rail_hole_z_offsets_mm.description: Rail hole centres used, measured upward from the panel bottom edge as it will sit in the rack. The same heights are used on the left and right rail. 1-8 values.

rail_screw_clearance_diameter_mm.description: Through-hole diameter for the rack screw (screw major diameter + your clearance).

rail_screw_head_diameter_mm.description: Rack screw (or washer) head diameter; the head must bear fully on the panel.

rail_slot_extra_length_mm.description: Horizontal slot elongation of each rail hole for side-to-side adjustment (0 = round hole).

rail_side_clearance_mm.description: Gap kept between anything behind the panel (stiffening ribs, shelf floor and walls) and the inner rail edge.

rack_clear_depth_mm.description: Free depth behind the panel front face (to rear rails, door, wall or cables) at the shelf's height.

shelf_depth_mm.description: Floor depth behind the front plate. The shelf hangs only from the front rail screws; keep it shallow.

side_wall_height_mm.description: Height of the two side walls above the floor top. They are the shelf's main stiffeners.

rear_lip_height_mm.description: Height of a lip along the rear floor edge above the floor top (0 = none). At most side_wall_height_mm.

vent_slot_count.description: Number of rounded vent slots through the floor (0 = none).

vent_slot_width_mm.description: Width of each vent slot (across the rack).

vent_slot_length_mm.description: Length of each vent slot along the depth, centred on the floor between front plate and rear lip.

vent_slot_pitch_mm.description: Centre-to-centre spacing of vent slots across the rack.

device_width_mm.description: Width of the device that will sit on the shelf.

device_depth_mm.description: Depth of that device, including anything sticking out at the back.

device_height_mm.description: Height of that device including feet.

fit_clearance_mm.description: Gap required between the device and each side wall, and between the device and the rear lip.

build_plate_x_mm.description: Usable build plate size, first axis (measure your printer).

build_plate_y_mm.description: Usable build plate size, second axis.

name.description: Output basename: 1-48 chars of a-z, 0-9 and '-', starting with a letter or digit.

units.description: All lengths are millimetres. Must be "mm".

facets.description: Polygon segments per circle ($fn). Holes are enlarged so the polygon still clears the stated diameter.

min_wall_mm.description: Minimum material left between any hole/counterbore and a part edge or another hole.

part.description: Selects an external strap-retained power-strip/PDU bracket. One bracket is generated; print one per entry in bracket_x_positions_mm. Non-electrical accessory: it never touches outlets, switches, vents or the cord exit, and needs no change to the strip's case.

device_length_mm.description: Strip body length (end to end, excluding cord and plugs).

device_width_mm.description: Strip body width across the face that rests on the bracket base.

device_height_mm.description: Strip body height from the face on the base to the opposite (top) face.

fit_clearance_mm.description: Gap between the strip and each side wall, and between the strip top and the strap slot bottom.

top_face_keepouts_mm.description: Regions on the face opposite the base (usually outlets, switch, LEDs, including plug bodies) as [x0, x1, y0, y1]: x from the strip's left end, y across the face from its near (-y) edge. 0-12 rectangles.

side_face_keepouts_mm.description: Regions on either long side face (vents, switch, side outlets, side cord exit) as [x0, x1, z0, z1]: z up from the base face. Applied to both sides. 0-12 rectangles.

base_face_keepouts_mm.description: Regions on the face resting on the base (vents, labels you need to read, feet) as [x0, x1, y0, y1]. 0-12 rectangles.

keepout_margin_mm.description: Extra distance kept along the strip between each bracket (and its strap) and every keepout region.

end_clearance_mm.description: Minimum distance from each bracket to both strip ends (cord exit, strain relief, end switches).

bracket_x_positions_mm.description: Bracket centres along the strip, from its left end. 2-4 values (one bracket would let the strip pivot).

strap_width_mm.description: Width of the strap you will use (hook-and-loop, tie).

strap_clearance_mm.description: Added to strap width and thickness to size the wall slots.

strap_bar_height_mm.description: Wall material above each strap slot that the strap wraps around.

ear_width_mm.description: Width of the screw ear on each side of the walls.

mount_screw_clearance_diameter_mm.description: Through-hole diameter for the mounting screw, one per ear.

mount_screw_head_diameter_mm.description: Mounting screw (or washer) head diameter; it must bear on the ear clear of the wall.

max_overall_width_mm.description: Available width on the mounting surface across the strip.

max_overall_height_mm.description: Available height off the mounting surface (e.g. gap to a door or side panel), including the strap loop.

build_plate_x_mm.description: Usable build plate size, first axis (measure your printer).

build_plate_y_mm.description: Usable build plate size, second axis.
